systems.name: Funding Apprenticeship Earnings
systems.description: This system appears to manage earnings profiles, payments, and learning data associated with apprenticeship and short course programs. It supports operations like generating earnings, approving learning programs, and recalculating earnings profiles.
capabilities: Integration with external APIs for earnings management

systems.name: Payments V2 Datalocks
systems.description: This system appears to handle the processing, validation, and management of data lock events related to apprenticeship payments. It includes functionality for reacting to events such as apprenticeship status changes and updates, as well as managing cache and actor resets.

systems.name: Commitments
systems.description: The system manages apprenticeship commitments, tracking their statuses, updates, approvals, and associated party relationships. It also handles tasks like cohort management, apprenticeship training assignments, data synchronization, and notifications.

systems.name: Reservations API
systems.description: The system manages reservations for accounts, courses, and providers. It supports querying, creating, updating, and deleting reservations while handling associated account and course details.

systems.name: Employer Accounts
systems.description: The system manages employer accounts, including legal entities, PAYE schemes, agreements, team memberships, and notifications. It provides functionality for creating, updating, deleting, and managing these entities, as well as tracking levy statuses and processing related agreements.

systems.name: Reservations
systems.description: This system manages apprenticeship reservation data and provides functionality for caching, creating, deleting, and querying reservations. It interacts with funding rules, training dates, employer accounts, and courses.
